title: Amazingly Dense Moroccan Potato Khlea
description: A nutty and dense Moroccan dish featuring potato starch, perfect for a hangover cure, made with plant-based ingredients in a khlea form and served in a bento box.

ingredients.name: potato starch
ingredients.notes: make sure to use a high quality starch

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the potato starch, chickpea flour, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Gradually add in the olive oil and water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 6 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place in a bento box.
Bake the khlea in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the khlea from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
